title: Band Engineering of Benzothiadiazole‐Derived Metal‐Organic Frameworks for Photocatalytic Organic Transformations
innovation: ABSTRACT Metal‐organic frameworks (MOFs) have emerged as versatile platforms for photocatalysis, with their activity intrinsically governed by electronic structure.
limitations: Electronic-structure trends may be stronger than finite-temperature dynamics, solvent, or kinetics. Catalytic conclusions are likely thermodynamics-heavy unless kinetics or explicit environment are included.
next_steps: Test humid or multicomponent conditions and connect material metrics to process-level targets. Add kinetics, explicit environment effects, and active-site reconstruction checks.
mof_relevance: Directly relevant to MOF work, but likely less novel for this transfer-focused profile.
mof_transfer_route: Use as direct MOF prior art or a benchmark for a more specific MOF task.
